drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un croquis : un trait droit épais, oblique, et une courbe fine qui le traverse en lui étant tangente — une courbe et sa tangente d'inflexion.
drawings.notes: Left margin, beside « D est une tangente d'inflexion ». A heavy straight oblique stroke (the line D) and a thin curve which comes up from below the line, touches it at one computed point with the same slope, runs along it and leaves it upwards on the other side: the curve crosses its tangent, as at a point of inflection. On the page the curve cannot be told from the line over about a third of the stroke; it is drawn tangent at one point (settled by the mathematics: the text names the figure). Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, les quatre points $\infty$, $0$, $1$, $t$ écrits sur une ligne (un petit point entre $0$ et $1$) et reliés deux à deux par des crochets : au-dessus, $\infty$ à $t$ et $0$ à $t$ ; au-dessous, $0$ à $1$ et $\infty$ à $1$.
drawings.kind: four points on a line joined in pairs by brackets
drawings.notes: The four symbols infinity, 0, 1, t on one line, with a small dot between 0 and 1. Four square brackets join them in pairs: above, a long one from infinity to t and a shorter one from 0 to t (their right ends coincide over t); below, a short one from 0 to 1 and a longer one from infinity to 1 (their right ends coincide under 1). The brackets are drawn with right angles between computed end points; on the page they are freehand and slightly slanted. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
